action: Turn on transaction notifications, never share verification codes with unexpected callers, and treat an unfamiliar digital wallet enrolment alert as possible fraud and call your bank.
exec: Australian card data commands a premium among fraudsters, and digital-wallet enrolment is a growing fraud route for issuers to monitor.
plain: Researchers found stolen Australian bank cards selling online for about $22 each, and criminals increasingly add them to phone wallets.
summary: NordVPN analysed more than 24,000 card listings on nine dark web marketplaces and found stolen Australian cards average US$14.52, roughly 45 per cent more than US cards. Cards bundled with ID details and birth dates fetch more, and forum discussion about loading stolen cards into Apple Pay and Google Pay nearly tripled in a year.
title: Report: stolen Australian payment cards sell for about A$22 on dark web markets

validation.note: One outlet reporting a vendor study; marketplace data was collected in February 2026.

review.note: Compared title, date 17 Nov, 24,000 listings/nine marketplaces, US$14.52 (~A$22), 45% over US cards, wallet talk nearly tripled, Feb 2026 data against Cyber Daily.
